settings.capture_target.label: Capture target
settings.capture_target.description: What the bar pill and the control-center tile record.
settings.monitor.label: Monitor name
settings.monitor.description: Connector name, for example eDP-1 or HDMI-A-1. Run gpu-screen-recorder --list-monitors to list them.
settings.confirm_before_recording.label: Confirm before recording
settings.confirm_before_recording.descri: Show the canvas bar with the size that will be captured and Start and Cancel before the recording begins.
settings.frame_rate.label: Frame rate
settings.quality.label: Quality
settings.quality.description: Constant-quality preset. Ultra produces larger files and costs more CPU on the software encoder.
settings.codec.label: Video codec
settings.codec.description: H.264 is the most compatible and avoids the AMD black-bar problem with HEVC and AV1.
settings.container.label: Container
settings.container.description: MKV survives an interrupted recording better than MP4.
settings.audio_source.label: Audio
settings.audio_source.description: Recorded through PipeWire. The Sound button on the canvas bar mutes for the current session without changing this.
settings.encoder_mode.label: Encoder
settings.encoder_mode.description: Auto uses the GPU encoder and drops to the CPU when it is unavailable. CPU forces software encoding.
settings.gpu_preference.label: GPU preference
settings.gpu_preference.description: Best effort. gpu-screen-recorder encodes on the GPU that drives the captured monitor. If the preferred GPU is unavailable or fails, the recording retries on the default GPU and then on the CPU.
settings.low_power.label: Low power mode (AMD)
settings.low_power.description: Lets the AMD GPU drop to a lower power state while recording. It only affects AMD.
settings.record_cursor.label: Record the cursor
settings.record_cursor.description: Include the mouse pointer in the video.
settings.notify.label: Notifications
settings.notify.description: Show a notification when a recording starts, stops, or fails.
settings.output_dir.label: Output folder
settings.output_dir.description: Leave empty for the XDG videos folder, or ~/Videos/Screencasts.
confirm.region-tooltip: Select the area to capture again
confirm.audio-tooltip: Include desktop audio or mute it
panel.title: Screen recording
panel.choose: Choose what you want to capture
notify.busy: A recording is already in progress
notify.confirm-first: Confirm or cancel the pending recording first
notify.exited: gpu-screen-recorder exited before writing a file
